rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to tell someone information.

example.english: I’ll inform you that you don’t have to come to work tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我話畀你知，聽日唔使返工。
example.jyutping: ngo5 waa6 bei2 nei5 zi1 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1

rows.note: Use this for notifying someone, especially about an arrangement, decision, or official matter.

example.english: The company will inform us that tomorrow’s schedule has changed.
example.traditional: 公司會通知我哋聽日改時間。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 wui5 tung1 zi1 ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 goi2 si4 gaan3

rows.note: Use this colloquial word when someone rats on or denounces another person.

example.english: They actually inform on me, so the boss chews me out.
example.traditional: 佢竟然篤灰，搞到我畀老闆鬧。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ging2 jin4 duk1 fui1 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 bei2 lou5 baan2 naau6

rows.note: Use this for secretly reporting someone or revealing information to an authority in a serious or formal context.

example.english: He secretly chose to inform the police, exposing a smuggling ring.
example.traditional: 佢向警方告密，揭發咗個走私集團。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hoeng3 ging2 fong1 gou3 mat6 kit3 faat3 zo2 go3 zau2 si1 zaap6 tyun4
